## The heuristic

**How an account buys predicts the outcome better than what the account is.
**


_Why:_ Committee size, whether procurement runs the process, whether anyone there has bought in this category before — these separate won from lost more sharply than industry or headcount, and they are the dimensions nobody writes down because they cannot be bought from an enrichment vendor. An eighty-person company that runs security review is an enterprise buyer; a five-thousand-person company buying on a card is not.
